explication: NeuTTS is an on-device text-to-speech library built around language-model backbones and neural audio codecs. The main workflow accepts text and a speaker reference, prepares model input, generates speech tokens, decodes them to audio, and returns a waveform; GGUF models also support streaming. The graph preserves the Air and emotional 2E variants, multilingual phonemization, cloning, and watermarking. Some internal inference details and codec wiring are only partially excerpted, so edges are limited to documented or visible relationships.
